analysis.reasonEn: RSI declined to 34.1 after entering oversold territory. MACD histogram remains weak at -9.2615. ADX is 31.4 indicating a clear trend, but -DI (30.9) significantly outweighs +DI (13.8), suggesting downward pressure. Volume ratio below 0.7 for 5 consecutive days indicates lethargic movement. Current price ($2,266.16) is near the lower Bollinger Band ($2,223.59). While the 52-week position is low at 31.5%, considering the divergence from medium-to-long term moving averages (SMA100: $2,344.65, SMA200: $2,157.65) and the weekly ADX of 18.9 (non-trending), further downside is possible. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
